data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 Switzerland factsheet summarizes how 15-year-old students in Switzerland performed in mathematics, reading, and science, and how results changed over time (notably comparing 2018, 2015, and earlier cycles). It reports mean performance trends and proficiency distributions (e.g., shares at Level 2 and Level 5/6) using OECD’s PISA 2022 database tables, with uncertainty shown via 95% confidence intervals. The factsheet also highlights within-country gaps by socio-economic status, gender differences, and immigrant background, and it includes contextual information on school climate, parental involvement, and experiences during COVID-related closures. Switzerland is reported as meeting PISA technical quality standards for reporting in 2022, and the factsheet notes that some countries/economies with an asterisk may have sampling-standard issues (not applicable to Switzerland here). No machine-learning modeling or predictive evaluation is conducted in this document; it is descriptive reporting of assessment outcomes.
